messages:
vikram: quick sync — we need a concrete ingest contract from runtime/infra so product can ship the unified \"unit price\" dashboard. scope: cost per 1k tokens, cache/batch savings, and per-route breakouts. who can own the telemetry proto?
alana: I can pair on the event names. off the top: token.count, token.source (prompt|completion), kv_cache.hit, batch.size, model.variant, route, region, customer_tier. need cardinality limits though.
jess: product: UX wants these rollups: per-1k cost (avg + p95), cache_savings_pct, batching_efficiency (requests_per_batch). also ability to filter by model & route. visual: waterfall for cache vs batching savings.
ryan: from platform: agree on names. also need guidance on how to derive cost_per_1k: runtime should emit token.count and time.ms per request? or we compute cost using unit rates in the costing service? prefer compute in analytics to keep runtime light.
maya: observability: we want both event stream (low cardinality) and metrics (prom histos) for p95 latency & batch sizes. propose coarse telemetry events for each request + aggregated counters every minute to avoid high cardinality.
vikram: proposal: runtime emits low-cardinality event per request with fields: model, route, tokens_in, tokens_out, batch_size, kv_cache_hit:boolean, region, tenant_tier. then infra aggregates into 1m rollups with tags: model, route, region, tenant_tier. costing service will join rollups with pricing table to compute cost/1k.
alana: proto sketch:

```json
{
  \"event_type\": \"inference.request\",
  \"model\": \"gpt-4o-mini\",
  \"route\": \"chat.v1.generate\",
  \"region\": \"us-west-2\",
  \"tenant_tier\": \"dedicated\",
  \"tokens_in\": 34,
  \"tokens_out\": 287,
  \"batch_size\": 6,
  \"kv_cache_hit\": true,
  \"latency_ms\": 142
}
```
ryan: couple of notes: 1) please keep model and route as enumerated strings to avoid free-form; 2) kv_cache_hit should be optional and we should also emit kv_cache_saved_tokens when available so we can compute token savings directly.
jess: product follow-ups: 1) dashboards need rollouts UX (canary per-customer_tier) so we can compare cost delta during model switches. 2) we need an annotation feed for rollouts so cost regressions show which variant was serving.
maya: retention & storage: we can't keep full events for >30d at scale. plan: 7d raw events in event lake, 90d aggregated rollups in analytics, 13mo cost-forwarding for finance. Is that ok for product?
jess: yes — 7d raw + 90d rollups is fine for initial. finance will ask for exports, we can add export job.
vikram: open questions: sampling strategy for high-volume customers (dedicated pools excluded?), cardinality explosion for route+customer_id combos, and how to tag internal fallback routes.
ryan: suggestion: sample 100% for dedicated customers, 5% for hosted high-volume tiers by default and allow per-tenant opt-in via config. store sampled_count in rollup so downstream can scale up.
alana: also add `cache_saved_tokens` field to proto for when KV cache returns partial prefix — makes savings math simpler.
maya: infra will add these fields to the telemetry schema and provide a schema PR this week. we'll also add a nightly batch to compute per-1k cost and write to analytics table: cost_per_1k, cache_savings_pct, batching_efficiency_pct, p95_latency_ms.
vikram: rollout plan: week 1 instrument runtime -> emit event schema (canary on staging). week 2 deploy aggregator + analytics joins, product mock dashboard with synthetic data. week 3 enable host customers in alpha, gather signals, tweak sampling. target: dashboard beta in 4 weeks.
jess: I'll own dashboard mock + annotation timeline. can you engs add a sample query for the analytics table? product wants example SQL for how we'll compute cost_per_1k.
ryan: sample SQL (pseudo):

```sql
SELECT
  model,
  route,
  SUM(tokens_in + tokens_out) / SUM(requests) * 1000 AS avg_tokens_per_1k,
  SUM(cost_usd) / (SUM(tokens_in + tokens_out) / 1000) AS cost_per_1k,
  SUM(cache_saved_tokens) / SUM(tokens_in + tokens_out) AS cache_savings_pct,
  SUM(batch_size * requests) / SUM(requests) AS avg_batch_size
FROM analytics.inference_rollups
WHERE ts BETWEEN @start AND @end
GROUP BY model, route
```
maya: aggregator will emit cost_usd if we wire pricing table in the nightly job — otherwise product can compute by joining with pricing table keyed by model and qformat.
alana: tiny nit: name the kv field `kv_cache_saved_tokens` to be explicit.
vikram: agreed. action items:
- maya: PR telemetry schema + aggregator timeline (this week)
- alana: add proto fields + validation in runtime (next 5 working days)
- ryan: sampling & storage config + sample SQL (this week)
- jess: dashboard mock + annotation UX (2 weeks)
- vikram: coordinate canary plan and product signoff (ongoing)
ingest-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-schema-pr -> staging at 2023-06-12T18:30:00Z :white_check_mark:
jess: thanks all — let's reconvene Thurs 10am PT after maya's PR lands. :thumbsup:
